scope: Conditional association checks at all 40 computed candidates from the completed four-case source comparison. Each computed point and inferred clock stays fixed. No recording clock or known position is supplied to this check.
interpretation: Extra passing curves occur at both nearby and distant candidates. An extra match by itself does not establish a correct location. Coarse range and speed checks reject the extra first-clip association.

prior_hinted_diagnostic.scope: Separate conditional check of the later clip at the first estimate from an earlier known-area search. This check supplies a position and an inferred clock and cannot count as location acceptance.

plan.scope: Conditional model diagnostic at the first estimate from an earlier known-area diagnostic. Supplied point and inferred clock disqualify this as a broad-area location test.
